description: Source code for the Monitor plugin implementation in the WPEFramework, handling initialization, deinitialization, request processing, and monitoring data management.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: Main class implementing the monitoring plugin with methods for lifecycle management and request processing.

methods.name: Monitor::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the monitor plugin, sets up configuration, and registers monitoring services.

methods.name: Monitor::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters services during shutdown.

methods.name: Monitor::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently no additional info.

methods.name: Monitor::Inbound
methods.description: Prepares request body for POST and PUT requests.

methods.name: Monitor::Process
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests for monitoring data retrieval, reset, and updates.
